name: nta-student
description: Study the Nutritional Therapy Association's curriculum with NTAI: a study session that knows where you are in each lesson (lesson checks, study guides and practice rounds on your weak spots, with hints before answers, and readiness for your workshops), answers checked against NTA's material with numbered sources, search of the modules you have completed, graded test questions taught rather than answered, and NTA's scope-of-practice rules. Needs an NTA account with a program enrollment.
